57_1_1: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon — our beloved friend and fellow worker —
57_1_2: and to Apphia our sister, and to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets in your house:
57_1_3: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
57_1_4: I thank my God always when I remember you in my prayers,
57_1_5: because I keep hearing of your love and of the faith you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints.
57_1_6: And I pray that the fellowship of your faith may become effective — through the full knowledge of every good thing that is in us for Christ's sake.
57_1_7: For I have had much joy and encouragement from your love, brother — because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you.
57_1_8: Therefore, although I have plenty of boldness in Christ to order you to do what is fitting,
57_1_9: yet for love's sake I prefer to appeal to you. I — Paul, an old man, and now also a prisoner of Christ Jesus —
57_1_10: I appeal to you for my child, whom I have begotten in my chains: Onesimus.
57_1_11: Once he was useless to you — but now he has become truly useful, both to you and to me.
57_1_12: I am sending him back to you — that is, my own heart.
57_1_13: I would have liked to keep him with me, so that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the gospel.
57_1_14: But without your consent I did not want to do anything, so that your good deed would not be by compulsion, but of your own free will.
57_1_15: For perhaps this is why he was separated from you for a little while — so that you might have him back forever:
57_1_16: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave — a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
57_1_17: So if you consider me a partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.
57_1_18: And if he has wronged you in any way, or owes you anything, charge that to my account.
57_1_19: I, Paul, am writing this with my own hand: I will repay it — without mentioning that you owe me even your own self.
57_1_20: Yes, brother — let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.
57_1_21: Confident of your obedience, I write to you — knowing that you will do even more than I say.
57_1_22: And one thing more — prepare a guest room for me, for I am hoping that through your prayers I will be given back to you.
57_1_23: Epaphras — my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus — sends you greetings,
57_1_24: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke — my fellow workers.
57_1_25: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
65_1_1: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James — to those who are called, beloved in God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
65_1_2: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
65_1_3: Beloved, while I was making every effort to write to you about our common salvation, I found it necessary to write urging you to contend earnestly for the faith — once for all delivered to the saints.
65_1_4: For certain men have crept in unnoticed — those who long ago were marked out for this condemnation. They are ungodly, perverting the grace of our God into licentiousness, and denying the only Master and our Lord, Jesus Christ.
65_1_5: Now I want to remind you — though you already know all this — that the Lord, having once saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who did not believe.
65_1_6: And the angels who did not keep their proper position, but abandoned their own dwelling — He has kept in eternal chains under darkness for the judgment of the great Day.
65_1_7: Just so, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding cities — which in like manner gave themselves over to sexual immorality and went after strange flesh — are set forth as an example, undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.
65_1_8: Yet in the same way these dreamers also defile the flesh, reject authority, and revile glorious beings.
65_1_9: But Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil and disputing about the body of Moses, did not dare bring against him a railing accusation — but said, "The Lord rebuke you!"
65_1_10: But these revile whatever they do not understand, and what they do understand by instinct — like irrational animals — these are the things by which they are destroyed.
65_1_11: Woe to them! For they have gone the way of Cain. They have rushed for profit into Balaam's error. They have perished in Korah's rebellion.
65_1_12: These are the hidden reefs at your love feasts — feasting with you fearlessly, shepherding only themselves: clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees, fruitless, twice dead, uprooted;
65_1_13: wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the gloom of darkness has been reserved forever.
65_1_14: It was also about these men that Enoch — the seventh from Adam — prophesied, saying: "Behold, the Lord came with myriads of His holy ones,
65_1_15: to execute judgment upon all, and to convict every soul of all the ungodly works they have committed in their ungodliness, and of all the harsh things ungodly sinners have spoken against Him."
65_1_16: These are grumblers, complainers, walking according to their own lusts. Their mouths speak arrogant words, flattering people for the sake of advantage.
65_1_17: But you, beloved, remember the words spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ —
65_1_18: how they kept telling you, "In the last time there will be mockers, walking according to their own ungodly lusts."
65_1_19: These are the ones who divide, who are unspiritual, devoid of the Spirit.
65_1_20: But you, beloved, building yourselves up in your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,
65_1_21: keep yourselves in the love of God — waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that brings eternal life.
65_1_22: And on some have mercy — those who waver;
65_1_23: save others, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear — hating even the garment stained by the flesh.
65_1_24: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of His glory with great joy —
65_1_25: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory and majesty, dominion and authority, before all time, now, and forevermore. Amen.
56_1_1: Paul, a bondservant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ — for the faith of God's chosen ones, and for the full knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,
56_1_2: in the hope of eternal life — which God, who cannot lie, promised before the ages of time began,
56_1_3: and at the proper time has manifested His word through the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior:
56_1_4: to Titus, my true son in our common faith — grace and peace from God the Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
56_1_5: For this reason I left you in Crete: that you might set in order what was lacking, and appoint elders in every city, just as I commanded you —
56_1_6: if anyone is above reproach, the husband of one wife, having children who believe and who are not accused of dissipation or rebellion.
56_1_7: For an overseer must be above reproach as God's steward — not arrogant, not quick-tempered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for gain;
56_1_8: but hospitable, a lover of what is good, sober-minded, righteous, holy, and self-controlled —
56_1_9: holding fast to the faithful word as he was taught, so that he may be able both to encourage by sound doctrine and to refute those who contradict.
56_1_10: For there are many rebellious men, empty talkers and deceivers — especially those of the circumcision —
56_1_11: whose mouths must be silenced. They are upsetting whole households by teaching, for the sake of dishonest gain, things they ought not to teach.
56_1_12: One of them — a prophet of their own — said, "Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons."
56_1_13: This testimony is true. For this reason, rebuke them sharply — so that they may be sound in the faith,
56_1_14: not paying attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who turn away from the truth.
56_1_15: To the pure, all things are pure — but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. Both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
56_1_16: They claim to know God, but by their deeds they deny Him — being detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
56_2_1: But as for you, speak the things that are fitting for sound doctrine.
56_2_2: Older men are to be sober-minded, dignified, self-controlled — sound in faith, in love, and in steadfastness.
56_2_3: Older women likewise — that they be reverent in behavior, not slanderers, not enslaved to much wine, teachers of what is good —
56_2_4: so that they may train the younger women to love their husbands, to love their children,
56_2_5: to be self-controlled, pure, working at home, kind, submissive to their own husbands — so that the word of God will not be discredited.
56_2_6: Likewise, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
56_2_7: In all things show yourself to be an example of good works — in your teaching showing integrity, dignity,
56_2_8: and sound speech that cannot be condemned — so that the opponent may be put to shame, having nothing evil to say about us.
56_2_9: Bondservants are to be subject to their own masters in everything, and to be well-pleasing — not arguing back,
56_2_10: not pilfering, but showing all good faith — so that in everything they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior.
56_2_11: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all people,
56_2_12: training us to renounce ungodliness and worldly desires, and to live sensibly, righteously, and godly in this present age,
56_2_13: looking for the blessed hope and glorious appearing of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ —
56_2_14: who gave Himself for us, to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good works.
56_2_15: These things speak — and exhort and rebuke with all authority. Let no one disregard you.
56_3_1: Remind them to be subject to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
56_3_2: to malign no one, to be peaceable and gentle, showing all humility to all people.
56_3_3: For we ourselves were once foolish, disobedient, deceived — slaves to various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
56_3_4: But when the kindness and the love of God our Savior toward man appeared,
56_3_5: He saved us — not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to His mercy — through the washing of regeneration and the renewing of the Holy Spirit,
56_3_6: which He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
56_3_7: so that, having been justified by His grace, we should become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
56_3_8: This saying is faithful — and concerning these things I want you to insist confidently, so that those who have believed in God may be careful to engage in good works. These things are good and profitable for people.
56_3_9: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, strife, and quarrels about the law — for they are useless and worthless.
56_3_10: Reject a divisive man after the first and second admonition,
56_3_11: knowing that such a one is warped and sinful — being self-condemned.
56_3_12: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis — for I have decided to spend the winter there.
56_3_13: Diligently send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way, so that nothing is lacking for them.
56_3_14: And let our people learn to engage in good works for cases of urgent need — so that they will not be unfruitful.
56_3_15: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
53_1_1: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy — to the church of the Thessalonians, in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
53_1_2: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
53_1_3: We are bound to thank God always for you, brothers, as is fitting — because your faith is growing exceedingly, and the love of every one of you for one another is abounding.
53_1_4: Therefore we ourselves boast about you among the churches of God — for your steadfastness and faith in all your persecutions and the afflictions you are enduring.
53_1_5: This is plain evidence of God's righteous judgment — that you may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are also suffering.
53_1_6: For after all, it is just with God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
53_1_7: and to give relief to you who are afflicted, and to us as well — when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels,
53_1_8: in flaming fire, taking vengeance on those who do not know God and who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
53_1_9: These will pay the penalty of eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of His might —
53_1_10: when He comes on that Day to be glorified in His saints and to be marveled at by all who have believed (because our testimony among you was believed).
53_1_11: To this end we always pray for you — that our God may count you worthy of His calling, and may fulfill every good resolve and every work of faith with power,
53_1_12: so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
53_2_1: Now we ask you, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him —
53_2_2: that you not be quickly shaken in mind, or alarmed — either by a spirit, or by a word, or by a letter seeming to be from us — to the effect that the day of the Lord has already come.
53_2_3: Let no one deceive you in any way. For that day will not come unless the falling away comes first, and the man of lawlessness is revealed — the son of destruction —
53_2_4: the one who opposes and exalts himself against every so-called god or object of worship, so that he takes his seat in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.
53_2_5: Do you not remember that, while I was still with you, I was telling you these things?
53_2_6: And now you know what is restraining him — so that he may be revealed in his own time.
53_2_7: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only the One who now restrains will do so until He is taken out of the way.
53_2_8: And then the lawless one will be revealed — whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth, and bring to nothing by the appearance of His coming.
53_2_9: The coming of the lawless one will be in accord with the working of Satan — with all power, and with signs and lying wonders,
53_2_10: and with all unrighteous deception for those who are perishing — because they refused to love the truth and so be saved.
53_2_11: For this reason, God sends them a working of error — so that they will believe the lie,
53_2_12: in order that all may be condemned who have not believed the truth, but have taken pleasure in unrighteousness.
53_2_13: But we are bound always to thank God for you, brothers beloved by the Lord — because God chose you from the beginning for salvation, through sanctification by the Spirit and faith in the truth,
53_2_14: to which He called you by our gospel — for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
53_2_15: So then, brothers, stand firm — and hold to the traditions you were taught, whether by spoken word or by letter from us.
53_2_16: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself, and God our Father — who has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope through grace —
53_2_17: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good word and work.
53_3_1: Finally, brothers, pray for us — that the word of the Lord may run swiftly and be glorified, just as it is with you,
53_3_2: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men — for not all have the faith.
53_3_3: But the Lord is faithful. He will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
53_3_4: And we have confidence in the Lord concerning you — that you are doing, and will do, the things we command.
53_3_5: May the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the steadfastness of Christ.
53_3_6: Now we command you, brothers — in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ — that you withdraw from every brother who walks in disorder, and not according to the tradition that you received from us.
53_3_7: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us — because we did not behave disorderly among you,
53_3_8: nor did we eat anyone's bread without paying for it. Rather, with toil and labor we worked night and day, so as not to be a burden to any of you —
53_3_9: not because we have no right, but in order to give ourselves to you as a model to imitate.
53_3_10: For even when we were with you, we used to give you this command: "If anyone is not willing to work, neither shall he eat."
53_3_11: For we hear that some among you are walking in disorder — not working at all, but being busybodies.
53_3_12: Now such persons we command and exhort, in the Lord Jesus Christ, to work quietly and to eat their own bread.
53_3_13: But as for you, brothers — do not grow weary in doing what is right.
53_3_14: If anyone does not obey our word in this letter, take note of him and have nothing to do with him — so that he may be ashamed.
53_3_15: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
53_3_16: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times, in every way. The Lord be with you all.
53_3_17: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. This is the sign in every letter — this is how I write.
53_3_18: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
61_1_1: Simon Peter, a bondservant and apostle of Jesus Christ — to those who have obtained a faith of equal standing with ours, by the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:
61_1_2: Grace and peace be multiplied to you in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
61_1_3: His divine power has granted to us all things pertaining to life and godliness, through the full knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence —
61_1_4: by which He has granted to us His precious and very great promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through evil desire.
61_1_5: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;
61_1_6: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;
61_1_7: and to godliness, brotherly affection; and to brotherly affection, love.
61_1_8: For if these qualities are yours and are increasing, they keep you from being ineffective or unfruitful in the full knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
61_1_9: For the one who lacks these things is so nearsighted that he is blind — having forgotten the cleansing from his former sins.
61_1_10: Therefore, brothers, be all the more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble —
61_1_11: for in this way, the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will be richly supplied to you.
61_1_12: For this reason I will always be ready to remind you of these things — though you know them, and are established in the truth that is with you.
61_1_13: I think it right, as long as I am in this body, to stir you up by way of reminder —
61_1_14: knowing that the laying aside of my body will be soon, just as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
61_1_15: And I will make every effort, so that after my departure you will always be able to call these things to remembrance.
61_1_16: For we did not follow cleverly devised myths when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ — but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.
61_1_17: For when He received honor and glory from God the Father, when such a voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory: "This is My beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased" —
61_1_18: we ourselves heard this voice come from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.
61_1_19: And we have the prophetic word made even more sure — to which you do well to pay attention, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
61_1_20: Knowing this first: that no prophecy of Scripture comes from one's own interpretation.
61_1_21: For no prophecy was ever produced by the will of man — but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.
61_2_1: But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you — who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them — bringing on themselves swift destruction.
61_2_2: And many will follow their licentiousness, and because of them the way of truth will be blasphemed.
61_2_3: And in their greed they will exploit you with deceptive words. Their condemnation, from long ago, is not idle — and their destruction is not asleep.
61_2_4: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to hell and committed them to chains of gloomy darkness, kept until the judgment;
61_2_5: and if He did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah, a herald of righteousness, with seven others, when He brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly;
61_2_6: and if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by reducing them to ashes, making them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly;
61_2_7: and if He rescued righteous Lot, who was distressed by the licentious behavior of lawless men —
61_2_8: for as that righteous man lived among them day after day, his righteous soul was tormented by what he saw and heard of their lawless deeds —
61_2_9: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trial, and how to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment;
61_2_10: and especially those who walk according to the flesh in defiling lust, and who despise authority. Bold and arrogant, they are not afraid to revile glorious beings —
61_2_11: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, do not bring a reviling judgment against them before the Lord.
61_2_12: But these, like irrational animals, born of nature to be caught and destroyed — speaking abusively about things they do not understand — will also be destroyed in their corruption,
61_2_13: suffering wrong as the wages for doing wrong. They count it pleasure to revel in broad daylight. They are spots and blemishes, reveling in their own deceptions while they feast with you.
61_2_14: Their eyes are full of adultery and never cease from sin. They entice unsteady souls. They have hearts trained in greed — accursed children!
61_2_15: Forsaking the right way, they have gone astray. They have followed the way of Balaam, son of Beor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness —
61_2_16: but he was rebuked for his own transgression: a speechless donkey spoke with a man's voice and restrained the prophet's madness.
61_2_17: These are springs without water, and mists driven by a storm. The gloom of darkness has been reserved for them.
61_2_18: For when they speak arrogant, empty words, they entice — by lusts of the flesh, by sensuality — those who are barely escaping from the ones who live in error.
61_2_19: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves of corruption — for whatever overcomes a man, by that he is enslaved.
61_2_20: For if, after escaping the defilements of the world through the full knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in them and overcome — the last state has become worse for them than the first.
61_2_21: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than, having known it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
61_2_22: For them the true proverb has come true: "A dog returns to its own vomit," and, "A washed sow returns to wallowing in the mire."
61_3_1: This is now, beloved, the second letter I am writing to you — in both of which I am stirring up your sincere mind by way of reminder,
61_3_2: that you should remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets, and the commandment of the Lord and Savior given through your apostles —
61_3_3: knowing this first: that scoffers will come in the last days, walking according to their own lusts,
61_3_4: and saying, "Where is the promise of His coming? For ever since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of creation."
61_3_5: For they deliberately overlook this fact: that long ago by the word of God the heavens existed, and the earth was formed out of water and through water,
61_3_6: by which the world that then existed was destroyed by being flooded with water.
61_3_7: But by the same word, the present heavens and earth are stored up for fire — being kept until the day of judgment and the destruction of ungodly people.
61_3_8: But do not overlook this one fact, beloved: with the Lord, one day is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
61_3_9: The Lord is not slow concerning His promise, as some count slowness — but He is patient toward you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should reach repentance.
61_3_10: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief — in which the heavens will pass away with a roar, and the elements will be dissolved with intense heat, and the earth and the works that are on it will be exposed.
61_3_11: Since all these things are to be dissolved in this way, what kind of people ought you to be — in holy conduct and godliness,
61_3_12: looking for and hastening the coming of the day of God, on account of which the heavens will be set on fire and dissolved, and the elements will melt with intense heat?
61_3_13: But according to His promise, we are looking for new heavens and a new earth — in which righteousness dwells.
61_3_14: Therefore, beloved — since you are looking for these things — be diligent to be found by Him in peace, spotless and blameless.
61_3_15: And consider the patience of our Lord as salvation — just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you, according to the wisdom given to him,
61_3_16: speaking of these things in all his letters — in which there are some things hard to understand, which the ignorant and unstable distort, as they do also the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.
61_3_17: You therefore, beloved — knowing this beforehand — be on guard, so that you are not carried away by the error of the lawless and lose your own steadfastness.
61_3_18: But grow in the grace and full knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
55_1_1: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus —
55_1_2: to Timothy, my beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
55_1_3: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as my forefathers did — as I constantly remember you in my prayers, night and day.
55_1_4: Recalling your tears, I long to see you, that I may be filled with joy.
55_1_5: I am reminded of the sincere faith within you — which first lived in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and now, I am persuaded, lives in you also.
55_1_6: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
55_1_7: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
55_1_8: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me His prisoner — but share with me in suffering for the gospel, by the power of God,
55_1_9: who has saved us and called us with a holy calling — not according to our works, but according to His own purpose and the grace given to us in Christ Jesus before the ages of time began,
55_1_10: and now has been revealed through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus — who has abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,
55_1_11: for which I was appointed a herald, an apostle, and a teacher.
55_1_12: For this reason I also suffer these things — but I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that He is able to guard what I have entrusted to Him until that Day.
55_1_13: Hold fast the pattern of sound words that you have heard from me — in the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
55_1_14: Guard the good deposit entrusted to you, by the Holy Spirit who lives in us.
55_1_15: You know this: that all who are in Asia have turned away from me — among them Phygelus and Hermogenes.
55_1_16: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus — for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chains.
55_1_17: But when he was in Rome, he sought me out diligently and found me.
55_1_18: May the Lord grant him to find mercy from the Lord on that Day. And you know very well how many ways he served at Ephesus.
55_2_1: You therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
55_2_2: And the things you have heard from me through many witnesses — entrust these to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.
55_2_3: Share in suffering, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
55_2_4: No one engaged in warfare entangles himself with the affairs of civilian life, so that he may please the one who enlisted him.
55_2_5: And if anyone competes in athletics, he is not crowned unless he competes according to the rules.
55_2_6: The hardworking farmer ought to be the first to share in the crops.
55_2_7: Consider what I say — for the Lord will give you understanding in everything.
55_2_8: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David, according to my gospel —
55_2_9: for which I am suffering hardship to the point of being chained as a criminal. But the word of God is not chained.
55_2_10: Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the chosen ones — so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
55_2_11: This saying is faithful: For if we have died with Him, we shall also live with Him.
55_2_12: If we endure, we shall also reign with Him. If we deny Him, He also will deny us.
55_2_13: If we are faithless, He remains faithful — for He cannot deny Himself.
55_2_14: Remind them of these things — charging them in the presence of God not to wrangle about words. It is to no profit, only the ruin of those who hear.
55_2_15: Be diligent to present yourself approved to God — a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth.
55_2_16: But avoid worldly and empty chatter, for it will lead to more ungodliness,
55_2_17: and their word will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
55_2_18: who have strayed from the truth — saying that the resurrection has already taken place. They are upsetting the faith of some.
55_2_19: Nevertheless, the firm foundation of God stands — having this seal: "The Lord knows those who are His," and, "Let everyone who names the name of the Lord turn away from unrighteousness."
55_2_20: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and earthenware — some for honorable use, some for common.
55_2_21: Therefore, if anyone cleanses himself from these things, he will be a vessel for honor — sanctified, useful to the Master, prepared for every good work.
55_2_22: Flee youthful lusts. And pursue righteousness, faith, love, peace — with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
55_2_23: But have nothing to do with foolish and ignorant disputes — knowing that they generate strife.
55_2_24: And the Lord's bondservant must not be quarrelsome — but kind to all, able to teach, patient when wronged,
55_2_25: in gentleness correcting those who are in opposition. Perhaps God will grant them repentance, leading to a full knowledge of the truth,
55_2_26: and they may come to their senses — escaping the snare of the devil, who has held them captive to do his will.
55_3_1: But know this: that in the last days perilous times will come.
55_3_2: For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy,
55_3_3: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, brutal, despisers of good,
55_3_4: treacherous, reckless, conceited — lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
55_3_5: having a form of godliness, but denying its power. Avoid such people.
55_3_6: For from these are those who creep into households and captivate weak women weighed down with sins, led away by various lusts —
55_3_7: always learning, and never able to come to the full knowledge of the truth.
55_3_8: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth — men of corrupt mind, disqualified concerning the faith.
55_3_9: But they will not advance further. For their folly will be plain to all, just as also that of those men became.
55_3_10: But you have followed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my steadfastness,
55_3_11: my persecutions, my sufferings — what happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet out of them all the Lord rescued me.
55_3_12: Indeed, all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
55_3_13: But evil men and impostors will go from bad to worse — deceiving and being deceived.
55_3_14: But as for you — continue in the things you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
55_3_15: And how from infancy you have known the holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
55_3_16: All Scripture is breathed out by God, and is profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for training in righteousness —
55_3_17: so that the man of God may be complete, equipped for every good work.
55_4_1: I solemnly charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus — who will judge the living and the dead, and by His appearing and His kingdom:
55_4_2: Preach the word. Be ready in season and out of season. Reprove, rebuke, exhort — with all patience and instruction.
55_4_3: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine — but according to their own desires they will accumulate for themselves teachers, having itching ears.
55_4_4: And they will turn their ears away from the truth, and turn aside to myths.
55_4_5: But you, be sober in all things. Endure suffering. Do the work of an evangelist. Fulfill your ministry.
55_4_6: For I am already being poured out as a drink offering, and the time of my departure has come.
55_4_7: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the race. I have kept the faith.
55_4_8: Henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord — the righteous Judge — will give to me on that Day. And not only to me, but also to all who have loved His appearing.
55_4_9: Be diligent to come to me quickly.
55_4_10: For Demas, having loved this present world, has forsaken me and gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
55_4_11: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for ministry.
55_4_12: Tychicus I have sent to Ephesus.
55_4_13: When you come, bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus — and the books, especially the parchments.
55_4_14: Alexander the coppersmith did me much harm. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
55_4_15: You also be on guard against him — for he greatly opposed our message.
55_4_16: At my first defense, no one stood with me — all forsook me. May it not be charged against them.
55_4_17: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me — so that through me the proclamation might be fully accomplished, and that all the Gentiles might hear it. And I was rescued from the lion's mouth.
55_4_18: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil deed, and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
55_4_19: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
55_4_20: Erastus stayed in Corinth. Trophimus I left sick at Miletus.
55_4_21: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, as do Pudens and Linus and Claudia, and all the brothers.
55_4_22: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all. Amen.
52_1_1: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy — to the church of the Thessalonians, in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you, and peace.
52_1_2: We give thanks to God always for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
52_1_3: constantly remembering before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
52_1_4: Knowing, brothers — beloved by God — your election;
52_1_5: for our gospel did not come to you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with full conviction — just as you know what kind of men we became among you for your sake.
52_1_6: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with the joy of the Holy Spirit —
52_1_7: so that you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and in Achaia.
52_1_8: For from you the word of the Lord has sounded forth — not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we have no need to say anything.
52_1_9: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of welcome we had among you — and how you turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God,
52_1_10: and to wait for His Son from heaven — whom He raised from the dead — Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
52_2_1: For you yourselves know, brothers, that our coming to you was not in vain.
52_2_2: But after we had previously suffered and been treated shamefully at Philippi — as you know — we had courage in our God to speak to you the gospel of God, in the midst of much opposition.
52_2_3: For our exhortation does not come from error, or from impurity, or by way of deceit;
52_2_4: but just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak — not as pleasing men, but God who tests our hearts.
52_2_5: For we never came with flattering speech, as you know — nor with a pretext for greed; God is witness.
52_2_6: Nor did we seek glory from people — neither from you, nor from others — when we could have made demands as apostles of Christ.
52_2_7: But we were gentle in your midst, like a nursing mother caring for her own children.
52_2_8: So, having a deep affection for you, we were well-pleased to share with you not only the gospel of God, but also our own lives — because you had become beloved to us.
52_2_9: For you remember, brothers, our toil and hardship — laboring night and day so as not to be a burden to any of you, while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
52_2_10: You are witnesses, and so is God — how holy, righteous, and blameless was our conduct toward you who believe.
52_2_11: Just as you know how, like a father with his own children, we were exhorting each one of you, and encouraging and imploring you,
52_2_12: that you should walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
52_2_13: And for this reason we also constantly thank God — that when you received the word of God which you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it truly is, the word of God — which also is at work in you who believe.
52_2_14: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Christ Jesus that are in Judea — for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen as they did from the Jews,
52_2_15: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out — and they do not please God, and are hostile to all people,
52_2_16: hindering us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved. Thus they always fill up the measure of their sins. But the wrath has come upon them at last.
52_2_17: But we, brothers — having been torn away from you for a short time, in person but not in heart — were all the more eager and longing to see your face.
52_2_18: For we wanted to come to you — I, Paul, more than once — but Satan hindered us.
52_2_19: For who is our hope, our joy, or our crown of boasting? Is it not even you, in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming?
52_2_20: For you are our glory and joy.
52_3_1: Therefore, when we could endure it no longer, we thought it best to be left behind in Athens alone,
52_3_2: and we sent Timothy — our brother and God's fellow worker in the gospel of Christ — to strengthen you and encourage you concerning your faith,
52_3_3: so that no one would be unsettled by these afflictions. For you yourselves know that we are appointed to this.
52_3_4: For indeed, when we were with you, we kept telling you in advance that we were going to suffer affliction — just as it has come to pass, as you know.
52_3_5: For this reason, when I could endure it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith — for fear that the tempter might have tempted you, and our labor would be in vain.
52_3_6: But now Timothy has come to us from you and brought us good news of your faith and love — and that you always have good remembrance of us, longing to see us, just as we long to see you.
52_3_7: For this reason, brothers — in all our affliction and distress — we were comforted concerning you through your faith.
52_3_8: For now we live, if you stand firm in the Lord.
52_3_9: For what thanksgiving can we render to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice on your account before our God,
52_3_10: as we keep praying earnestly night and day that we may see your face and supply what is lacking in your faith?
52_3_11: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
52_3_12: And may the Lord cause you to increase and abound in love for one another and for all people, just as we also do for you,
52_3_13: so that He may strengthen your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints.
52_4_1: Finally, then, brothers, we ask and exhort you in the Lord Jesus — that as you have received from us instruction concerning how you ought to walk and please God (just as you are doing) — that you excel still more.
52_4_2: For you know what commands we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
52_4_3: For this is the will of God: your sanctification — that you abstain from sexual immorality;
52_4_4: that each of you know how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor;
52_4_5: not in the passion of lust, like the Gentiles who do not know God;
52_4_6: and that no one transgress and defraud his brother in this matter — because the Lord is the avenger in all these things, just as we also told you before and warned solemnly.
52_4_7: For God did not call us for impurity, but for sanctification.
52_4_8: Therefore he who rejects this is not rejecting man, but God — who gives His Holy Spirit to you.
52_4_9: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need for anyone to write to you — for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another.
52_4_10: For indeed you do practice it toward all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel still more,
52_4_11: and to make it your ambition to live a quiet life, to mind your own business, and to work with your own hands — just as we commanded you,
52_4_12: so that you may walk properly toward outsiders, and have need of nothing.
52_4_13: But we do not want you to be uninformed, brothers, about those who have fallen asleep — so that you may not grieve like the rest, who have no hope.
52_4_14: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so, through Jesus, God will bring with Him those who have fallen asleep.
52_4_15: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord: that we who are alive — who remain until the coming of the Lord — will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.
52_4_16: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a shout — with the voice of an archangel and with the trumpet of God — and the dead in Christ will rise first.
52_4_17: Then we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we shall always be with the Lord.
52_4_18: Therefore, comfort one another with these words.
52_5_1: Now concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
52_5_2: For you yourselves know full well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
52_5_3: When they say, "Peace and safety!" — then sudden destruction will come upon them, like labor pains upon a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
52_5_4: But you, brothers, are not in darkness — that the day should overtake you like a thief.
52_5_5: You are all sons of light and sons of the day. We are not of the night, nor of darkness.
52_5_6: So then, let us not sleep, as do the others — but let us watch and be sober.
52_5_7: For those who sleep, sleep at night; and those who get drunk, are drunk at night.
52_5_8: But since we are of the day, let us be sober — putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and as a helmet, the hope of salvation.
52_5_9: For God did not appoint us to wrath — but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
52_5_10: who died for us, so that whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.
52_5_11: Therefore encourage one another and build one another up — just as you also are doing.
52_5_12: Now we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
52_5_13: and esteem them very highly in love, because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.
52_5_14: And we urge you, brothers — admonish those who are unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, be patient with all.
52_5_15: See that no one repays evil for evil — but always seek what is good for one another and for all people.
52_5_18: In everything give thanks — for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.
52_5_21: Test all things — hold fast to what is good.
52_5_22: Abstain from every form of evil.
52_5_23: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely. And may your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
52_5_24: Faithful is He who calls you — He will also do it.
52_5_26: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
52_5_27: I solemnly charge you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the brothers.
52_5_28: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
51_1_1: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother —
51_1_2: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you, and peace from God our Father.
51_1_3: We give thanks to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, always praying for you,
51_1_4: since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love that you have for all the saints,
51_1_5: because of the hope laid up for you in heaven — of which you have heard before in the word of the truth, the gospel,
51_1_6: which has come to you. Just as in all the world, it is bearing fruit and growing — as it has been doing among you also, since the day you heard and came to know the grace of God in truth,
51_1_7: just as you learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,
51_1_8: and who has made known to us your love in the Spirit.
51_1_9: For this reason, since the day we heard, we have not ceased to pray for you and to ask that you may be filled with the full knowledge of His will, in all spiritual wisdom and understanding —
51_1_10: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing to Him: bearing fruit in every good work, and growing in the full knowledge of God,
51_1_11: being strengthened with all power, according to the might of His glory, for all endurance and patience with joy —
51_1_12: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in light;
51_1_13: who has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and transferred us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,
51_1_14: in whom we have redemption — the forgiveness of sins.
51_1_15: He is the image of the invisible God — the firstborn over all creation;
51_1_16: for in Him all things were created — in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible — whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things have been created through Him and for Him.
51_1_17: And He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
51_1_18: And He is the head of the body — the church. He is the beginning, the firstborn from among the dead — so that in everything He may have the preeminence.
51_1_19: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,
51_1_20: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things — whether things on earth or things in heaven — having made peace through the blood of His cross.
51_1_21: And although you were once alienated and hostile in mind, doing evil deeds —
51_1_22: yet now He has reconciled you in His body of flesh through death — to present you holy, blameless, and beyond reproach before Him,
51_1_23: if indeed you continue in the faith, firmly grounded and steadfast — not moved away from the hope of the gospel which you have heard, which has been proclaimed in all creation under heaven, and of which I, Paul, became a minister.
51_1_24: I now rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and in my flesh I fill up what is lacking in the afflictions of Christ — for the sake of His body, which is the church —
51_1_25: of which I became a minister, according to the stewardship from God which was given to me for you, to fully carry out the word of God:
51_1_26: the mystery hidden from ages and from generations, but now revealed to His saints,
51_1_27: to whom God willed to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles — which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
51_1_28: Him we proclaim — admonishing every person and teaching every person in all wisdom — so that we may present every person mature in Christ.
51_1_29: For this I labor — striving according to His working which works in me with power.
51_2_1: For I want you to know how great a struggle I have for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not seen my face in person —
51_2_2: that their hearts may be encouraged, having been knit together in love and reaching all the riches of full assurance of understanding — to the full knowledge of God's mystery: Christ,
51_2_3: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
51_2_4: I say this so that no one may deceive you with persuasive arguments.
51_2_5: For though I am absent in body, yet I am with you in spirit — rejoicing to see your good order and the firmness of your faith in Christ.
51_2_6: Therefore, just as you received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk in Him —
51_2_7: rooted and built up in Him, and established in the faith, just as you were taught — overflowing in thanksgiving.
51_2_8: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, according to the tradition of men, according to the elementary principles of the world, and not according to Christ.
51_2_9: For in Him dwells all the fullness of the deity bodily,
51_2_10: and you are made full in Him — who is the head of every ruler and authority.
51_2_11: In Him also you were circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands — by the putting off of the body of the flesh — by the circumcision of Christ.
51_2_12: Buried with Him in baptism, in which you were also raised with Him through faith in the working of God, who raised Him from the dead.
51_2_13: And you, who were dead in your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh — God made alive together with Him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
51_2_14: having canceled the certificate of debt with its decrees that stood against us — and which was hostile to us. He has taken it out of the way, having nailed it to the cross.
51_2_15: Having disarmed the rulers and authorities, He made a public spectacle of them — triumphing over them in the cross.
51_2_16: Therefore, let no one judge you in food and drink, or with regard to a feast, a new moon, or a Sabbath day —
51_2_17: things which are a shadow of what is to come; but the substance belongs to Christ.
51_2_18: Let no one disqualify you, taking pleasure in self-abasement and the worship of angels — going on in detail about visions he has seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
51_2_19: and not holding fast to the Head — from whom the whole body, nourished and held together by joints and ligaments, grows with the growth that is from God.
51_2_20: If you died with Christ to the elementary principles of the world, why — as if you were still living in the world — do you submit yourselves to its decrees:
51_2_21: "Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch"?
51_2_22: (All these things refer to what perishes with use, in accord with the commandments and teachings of men.)
51_2_23: These things have indeed an appearance of wisdom in self-imposed worship, false humility, and severity to the body — but are of no value against fleshly indulgence.
51_3_1: Therefore, if you have been raised with Christ, seek the things above — where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.
51_3_2: Set your minds on things above, not on things on the earth.
51_3_3: For you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
51_3_4: When Christ — who is our life — appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
51_3_5: Therefore put to death whatever is earthly in you: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desire, and greed — which is idolatry.
51_3_6: On account of these things the wrath of God is coming upon the sons of disobedience —
51_3_7: in which you yourselves once walked when you lived in them.
51_3_8: But now, you yourselves are to put off all of these things: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and filthy speech from your mouth.
51_3_9: Do not lie to one another, since you have put off the old self with its practices,
51_3_10: and have put on the new self — which is being renewed in knowledge according to the image of Him who created him —
51_3_11: where there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free — but Christ is all, and is in all.
51_3_12: Therefore, as God's chosen ones — holy and beloved — put on hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
51_3_13: Bearing with one another, and forgiving one another — if anyone has a complaint against another. Just as the Lord forgave you, so you also must forgive.
51_3_14: And above all these things, put on love — which is the bond of perfection.
51_3_15: And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts — to which indeed you were called in one body. And be thankful.
51_3_16: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, in all wisdom — teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs — singing with thankfulness in your hearts to God.
51_3_17: And whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
51_3_18: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
51_3_19: Husbands, love your wives, and do not be embittered against them.
51_3_20: Children, obey your parents in everything — for this is well-pleasing to the Lord.
51_3_21: Fathers, do not provoke your children — so that they may not lose heart.
51_3_22: Bondservants, obey in everything your earthly masters — not with eye-service, as people-pleasers, but with sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord.
51_3_23: Whatever you do, do your work heartily — as for the Lord, and not for men;
51_3_24: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance. It is the Lord Christ whom you serve.
51_3_25: For the one who does wrong will be repaid for the wrong he has done — and there is no partiality.
51_4_1: Masters, treat your bondservants justly and fairly — knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
51_4_2: Devote yourselves to prayer — keeping alert in it, with thanksgiving.
51_4_3: Pray for us at the same time — that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, on account of which I am imprisoned —
51_4_4: that I may make it clear, in the way I ought to speak.
51_4_5: Walk in wisdom toward outsiders — making the most of the time.
51_4_6: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt — so that you will know how you should answer each one.
51_4_7: All my affairs Tychicus will make known to you — beloved brother, faithful minister, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
51_4_8: I have sent him to you for this very purpose — that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
51_4_9: He is coming with Onesimus — the faithful and beloved brother who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.
51_4_10: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, sends you greetings — and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions: if he comes to you, welcome him);
51_4_11: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are the only fellow workers from the circumcision for the kingdom of God — and they have been a comfort to me.
51_4_12: Epaphras, who is one of you, a bondservant of Christ Jesus, sends you greetings — always wrestling on your behalf in his prayers, that you may stand mature and fully assured in all the will of God.
51_4_13: For I bear him witness that he has worked hard for you, for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
51_4_14: Luke, the beloved physician, sends you greetings — as does Demas.
51_4_15: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, and Nympha and the church in her house.
51_4_16: And when this letter has been read among you, see that it is read also in the church of the Laodiceans — and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.
51_4_17: And say to Archippus, "Take care to fulfill the ministry that you have received in the Lord."
51_4_18: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
50_1_1: Paul and Timothy, bondservants of Christ Jesus — to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, with the overseers and deacons:
50_1_2: Grace to you, and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
50_1_3: I thank my God in all my remembrance of you,
50_1_4: always — in every prayer of mine for you all — making my prayer with joy,
50_1_5: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now.
50_1_6: I am confident of this very thing: that He who began a good work in you will bring it to completion at the day of Jesus Christ.
50_1_7: It is right for me to think this way about all of you — because I have you in my heart, since both in my chains and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, all of you share with me in this grace.
50_1_8: For God is my witness — how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
50_1_9: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound still more and more, in full knowledge and all discernment,
50_1_10: so that you may approve the things that are excellent — that you may be sincere and blameless until the day of Christ,
50_1_11: filled with the fruit of righteousness which comes through Jesus Christ — to the glory and praise of God.
50_1_12: Now I want you to know, brothers, that what has happened to me has actually served to advance the gospel,
50_1_13: so that my chains in Christ have become known throughout the whole praetorian guard, and to all the rest;
50_1_14: and most of the brothers, having confidence in the Lord because of my chains, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
50_1_15: Some, indeed, preach Christ even out of envy and rivalry — but others out of good will.
50_1_16: These do it out of love, knowing that I am put here for the defense of the gospel.
50_1_17: But the others proclaim Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely — supposing they will add affliction to my chains.
50_1_18: What then? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed — and in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice.
50_1_19: For I know that this will turn out for my deliverance through your prayer and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
50_1_20: according to my eager expectation and hope — that I will not be put to shame in anything, but that with all boldness, as always, even now Christ will be magnified in my body, whether through life or through death.
50_1_21: For to me, to live is Christ — and to die is gain.
50_1_22: But if I am to live on in the flesh, this will mean fruitful labor for me. Yet what I shall choose, I cannot tell.
50_1_23: I am hard-pressed between the two — having the desire to depart and be with Christ, for that is far better.
50_1_24: But to remain in the flesh is more necessary for your sake.
50_1_25: And being convinced of this, I know that I will remain — and I will continue with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
50_1_26: so that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus on account of me, through my coming to you again.
50_1_27: Only let your conduct be worthy of the gospel of Christ — so that whether I come and see you, or am absent, I may hear of your circumstances: that you stand firm in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel,
50_1_28: and not in any way frightened by your opponents. This is a sign of destruction to them, but of your salvation — and that from God.
50_1_29: For it has been granted to you for the sake of Christ — not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for His sake,
50_1_30: having the same conflict that you saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
50_2_1: If, then, there is any encouragement in Christ, any comfort of love, any fellowship of the Spirit, any affection and compassion,
50_2_2: make my joy complete — by being of the same mind, having the same love, being united in spirit, intent on one purpose.
50_2_3: Do nothing from selfish ambition or empty conceit. Rather, in humility consider others as more important than yourselves.
50_2_4: Do not look out only for your own interests, but also for the interests of others.
50_2_5: Have this mind among yourselves, which was also in Christ Jesus —
50_2_6: who, although He existed in the form of God, did not regard equality with God a thing to be grasped,
50_2_7: but emptied Himself, taking the form of a bondservant, being made in the likeness of men.
50_2_8: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself by becoming obedient — to the point of death, even death on a cross.
50_2_9: For this reason God highly exalted Him, and bestowed on Him the name that is above every name —
50_2_10: so that at the name of Jesus every knee will bow — of those in heaven, and on earth, and under the earth —
50_2_11: and that every tongue will confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
50_2_12: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed — not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence — work out your salvation with fear and trembling.
50_2_13: For it is God who is at work in you — both to will and to work for His good pleasure.
50_2_14: Do all things without grumbling and disputing,
50_2_15: so that you may be blameless and innocent — children of God without blemish, in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you shine as lights in the world,
50_2_16: holding fast the word of life — so that I may have reason to boast on the day of Christ that I did not run in vain, nor labor in vain.
50_2_17: But even if I am being poured out as a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice — and I rejoice with you all.
50_2_18: And in the same way, you also should rejoice — and rejoice with me.
50_2_19: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you shortly — so that I also may be encouraged when I learn of your circumstances.
50_2_20: For I have no one else of kindred spirit, who will genuinely care about your welfare.
50_2_21: For all of them seek their own interests — not those of Christ Jesus.
50_2_22: But you know of his proven worth — that as a child with a father, he served with me in the gospel.
50_2_23: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how things go with me.
50_2_24: And I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
50_2_25: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus — my brother and fellow worker and fellow soldier — your messenger and minister to my need.
50_2_26: For he was longing for all of you, and was distressed because you had heard that he was sick.
50_2_27: Indeed, he was sick to the point of death. But God had mercy on him — and not on him only, but also on me, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
50_2_28: Therefore I have sent him all the more eagerly — that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.
50_2_29: Welcome him in the Lord with all joy, and hold men like him in honor —
50_2_30: because he came close to death for the work of Christ, risking his life to fill up what was lacking in your service to me.
50_3_1: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things again is no trouble to me — and is a safeguard for you.
50_3_2: Beware of the dogs. Beware of the evil workers. Beware of the false circumcision.
50_3_3: For we are the true circumcision — who worship in the Spirit of God, and glory in Christ Jesus, and put no confidence in the flesh —
50_3_4: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If anyone else thinks he has reason to put confidence in the flesh, I have more:
50_3_5: circumcised the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
50_3_6: as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
50_3_7: But whatever things were gain to me, these I have counted as loss for the sake of Christ.
50_3_8: Indeed I count all things as loss for the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord — for whose sake I have suffered the loss of all things, and count them but rubbish, that I may gain Christ —
50_3_9: and be found in Him, not having a righteousness of my own which is from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ — the righteousness which is from God by faith;
50_3_10: that I may know Him, and the power of His resurrection, and the fellowship of His sufferings — being conformed to His death,
50_3_11: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
50_3_12: Not that I have already received it, or have already become perfect — but I press on, so that I may take hold of that for which I was also taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
50_3_13: Brothers, I do not regard myself as having yet taken hold of it. But one thing I do — forgetting what lies behind, and reaching forward to what lies ahead —
50_3_14: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.
50_3_15: Therefore as many as are mature, let us think this way. And if you think differently in any way, this also God will reveal to you.
50_3_16: Only let us live up to the standard we have already attained.
50_3_17: Brothers, join in following my example — and observe those who walk according to the pattern you have in us.
50_3_18: For many walk — of whom I have often told you, and now tell you even weeping — that they are enemies of the cross of Christ;
50_3_19: whose end is destruction, whose god is their belly, whose glory is in their shame, who set their minds on earthly things.
50_3_20: But our citizenship is in heaven — from which we also eagerly wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
50_3_21: who will transform our lowly body to be conformed to His glorious body — by the working by which He is able even to subject all things to Himself.
50_4_1: Therefore, my brothers — beloved and longed-for, my joy and crown — stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
50_4_2: I plead with Euodia and I plead with Syntyche — to be of the same mind in the Lord.
50_4_3: Yes, I ask you also, true companion, help these women who labored with me in the gospel — together with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.
50_4_4: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again — rejoice!
50_4_5: Let your gentleness be known to all people. The Lord is near.
50_4_6: Be anxious for nothing — but in everything, by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
50_4_7: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.
50_4_8: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is of good repute — if there is any excellence and if anything worthy of praise — dwell on these things.
50_4_9: The things you have learned and received and heard and seen in me — practice these things. And the God of peace will be with you.
50_4_10: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly — that now at last you have revived your concern for me. Indeed you were concerned, but you lacked opportunity.
50_4_11: Not that I am speaking from need — for I have learned, in whatever circumstances I am, to be content.
50_4_12: I know how to live humbly, and I know also how to live in abundance. In any and every circumstance, I have learned the secret — both how to be filled, and how to go hungry; both how to abound, and how to suffer need.
50_4_13: I can do all things through Him who strengthens me.
50_4_14: Nevertheless, you have done well to share with me in my affliction.
50_4_15: And you yourselves know, Philippians, that at the beginning of the gospel — when I left Macedonia — no church entered into partnership with me in the matter of giving and receiving, except you only.
50_4_16: For even at Thessalonica, you sent gifts more than once for my needs.
50_4_17: Not that I seek the gift — but I seek the fruit that is increasing to your account.
50_4_18: But I have received everything in full and have an abundance. I am amply supplied — having received from Epaphroditus the things you sent — a fragrant aroma, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
50_4_19: And my God will supply all your needs according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
50_4_20: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
50_4_21: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
50_4_22: All the saints greet you — especially those who are of Caesar's household.
50_4_23: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
60_1_1: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ — to the elect exiles of the dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
60_1_2: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, by the sanctification of the Spirit, for obedience and sprinkling with the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace and peace be multiplied to you.
60_1_3: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ — who according to His great mercy has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
60_1_4: to an inheritance imperishable, undefiled, and unfading — kept in heaven for you,
60_1_5: who through faith are being guarded by the power of God for the salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
60_1_6: In this you greatly rejoice — though now, for a little while if necessary, you have been distressed by various trials,
60_1_7: so that the proven character of your faith — more precious than gold which is perishable, even though tested by fire — may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
60_1_8: Whom not having seen, you love; in whom, though you do not see Him now, you believe — and rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory,
60_1_9: obtaining as the outcome of your faith the salvation of your souls.
60_1_10: Concerning this salvation, the prophets — who prophesied of the grace that was to come to you — sought and searched diligently,
60_1_11: inquiring as to what time, or what kind of time, the Spirit of Christ within them was pointing to, when He testified beforehand of the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow.
60_1_12: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you — in these things which now have been announced to you, through those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven; things into which angels long to look.
60_1_13: Therefore, gird up the loins of your mind. Be sober. Set your hope completely on the grace to be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
60_1_14: As obedient children, do not be conformed to the desires of your former ignorance,
60_1_15: but as the One who called you is holy, you also be holy in all your conduct;
60_1_16: because it is written, "Be holy, for I am holy."
60_1_17: And if you call on the Father — who without partiality judges according to each one's deeds — conduct yourselves in fear during the time of your pilgrimage,
60_1_18: knowing that you were not redeemed with perishable things, like silver or gold, from the futile way of life inherited from your fathers,
60_1_19: but with the precious blood of Christ — as of a lamb without blemish or spot.
60_1_20: He was foreknown before the foundation of the world, but has appeared in these last times for your sake,
60_1_21: who through Him are believers in God — who raised Him from the dead and gave Him glory — so that your faith and hope are in God.
60_1_22: Since you have purified your souls by your obedience to the truth — for sincere love of the brothers — love one another earnestly from a pure heart,
60_1_23: having been born again — not of perishable seed but of imperishable — through the living and abiding word of God.
60_1_24: For "all flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flower of grass. The grass withers, and the flower falls,
60_1_25: but the word of the Lord remains forever." And this is the word that was preached to you.
60_2_1: Therefore, putting aside all malice, all deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and all slander,
60_2_2: like newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the word — that by it you may grow up to salvation,
60_2_3: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is good.
60_2_4: Coming to Him — a living stone, rejected by men, but in the sight of God chosen and precious —
60_2_5: you yourselves, like living stones, are being built up as a spiritual house — to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
60_2_6: For it stands in Scripture: "Behold, I am laying in Zion a chosen stone, a precious cornerstone — and the one who believes in Him will not be put to shame."
60_2_7: Therefore the precious value is for you who believe. But to those who do not believe — "the stone the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone" —
60_2_8: and "a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense." They stumble because they are disobedient to the word — to which they were also appointed.
60_2_9: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's own possession — that you may proclaim the excellencies of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
60_2_10: Once you were not a people, but now you are God's people. Once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
60_2_11: Beloved, I urge you as foreigners and pilgrims — abstain from fleshly lusts, which wage war against the soul.
60_2_12: Keep your conduct among the Gentiles excellent — so that, in the very thing they slander you for as evildoers, they may by your good deeds, as they observe them, glorify God on the day of visitation.
60_2_13: Submit yourselves for the Lord's sake to every human institution — whether to the king as supreme,
60_2_14: or to governors as those sent by him to punish those who do evil and to praise those who do good.
60_2_15: For this is the will of God: that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
60_2_16: Live as free people — not using your freedom as a covering for evil, but as bondservants of God.
60_2_17: Honor everyone. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
60_2_18: Servants, submit yourselves with all respect to your masters — not only to those who are good and gentle, but also to those who are unreasonable.
60_2_19: For this is commendable — if for the sake of conscience toward God a person bears up under sorrows when suffering unjustly.
60_2_20: For what credit is it if, when you sin and are beaten for it, you endure? But if you do what is right and suffer for it, and you endure — this is commendable before God.
60_2_21: For to this you were called — because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in His steps.
60_2_22: He committed no sin, nor was deceit found in His mouth.
60_2_23: When He was reviled, He did not revile in return. When He suffered, He did not threaten — but kept entrusting Himself to the One who judges righteously.
60_2_24: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree — so that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. By His wounds you have been healed.
60_2_25: For you were like sheep going astray — but you have now returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
60_3_1: Likewise, wives — be subject to your own husbands, so that even if some are disobedient to the word, they may be won without a word by the conduct of their wives,
60_3_2: as they observe your pure and reverent conduct.
60_3_3: Let your adornment not be the outward — braiding the hair, wearing gold jewelry, or putting on fine clothing —
60_3_4: but the hidden person of the heart, with the imperishable beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which in God's sight is very precious.
60_3_5: For this is the way the holy women in former times — who hoped in God — adorned themselves, by being subject to their own husbands.
60_3_6: Just as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord — and you have become her children if you do good and are not frightened by any fear.
60_3_7: You husbands likewise — live with your wives in an understanding way, as with the weaker vessel, granting her honor as a fellow heir of the grace of life — so that your prayers may not be hindered.
60_3_8: Finally, all of you — be of one mind, sympathetic, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, humble in mind.
60_3_9: Not returning evil for evil, or insult for insult — but on the contrary, blessing. For to this you were called — that you may inherit a blessing.
60_3_10: For "the one who desires to love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
60_3_11: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
60_3_12: For the eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous, and His ears are attentive to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil."
60_3_13: And who is going to harm you, if you become zealous for what is good?
60_3_14: But even if you should suffer for the sake of righteousness — you are blessed. "Do not fear what they fear, and do not be troubled."
