60_3_15: But sanctify Christ as Lord in your hearts — always being ready to give a defense to anyone who asks you for an account of the hope that is in you, yet with gentleness and reverence.
60_3_16: Have a good conscience — so that those who slander your good behavior in Christ may be put to shame in the very thing they speak against.
60_3_17: For it is better, if it is the will of God, to suffer for doing what is right rather than for doing what is wrong.
60_3_18: For Christ also suffered once for sins — the righteous for the unrighteous — that He might bring us to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;
60_3_19: in which also He went and made proclamation to the spirits in prison —
60_3_20: those who once were disobedient when the patience of God kept waiting in the days of Noah, during the construction of the ark, in which a few — that is, eight souls — were brought safely through the water.
60_3_21: Corresponding to this, baptism now saves you — not the removal of dirt from the flesh, but the appeal to God for a good conscience — through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
60_3_22: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven — angels and authorities and powers having been subjected to Him.
60_4_1: Therefore, since Christ has suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same purpose — for the one who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin —
60_4_2: so as to live the rest of his time in the flesh no longer for human lusts, but for the will of God.
60_4_3: For the time already past is sufficient for having carried out the desire of the Gentiles — having pursued a course of sensuality, lusts, drunkenness, carousing, drinking parties, and abominable idolatries.
60_4_4: In all this they are surprised that you do not run with them into the same flood of debauchery — and they malign you.
60_4_5: But they will give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
60_4_6: For this reason the gospel was preached even to those who are dead — that though they are judged in the flesh as men, they may live in the spirit according to the will of God.
60_4_7: The end of all things is near. Therefore be sober-minded and self-controlled for prayer.
60_4_8: Above all, keep fervent in your love for one another — because love covers a multitude of sins.
60_4_9: Be hospitable to one another without complaint.
60_4_10: As each one has received a gift, employ it in serving one another — as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
60_4_11: Whoever speaks, let him do so as one who utters the words of God. Whoever serves, let him do so by the strength which God supplies — so that in everything God may be glorified through Jesus Christ. To Him belong the glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.
60_4_12: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that is taking place among you for your testing — as though something strange were happening to you.
60_4_13: But to the degree that you share the sufferings of Christ, rejoice — so that also at the revelation of His glory, you may rejoice with great gladness.
60_4_14: If you are reviled for the name of Christ, you are blessed — because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
60_4_15: By no means let any of you suffer as a murderer, or thief, or evildoer, or as a meddler in other people's affairs.
60_4_16: But if anyone suffers as a Christian, let him not be ashamed — but let him glorify God in this name.
60_4_17: For it is time for judgment to begin with the household of God. And if it begins with us first, what will be the end of those who do not obey the gospel of God?
60_4_18: And "if the righteous one is scarcely saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?"
60_4_19: Therefore, let those who suffer according to the will of God entrust their souls to a faithful Creator in doing what is right.
60_5_1: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as your fellow elder and witness of the sufferings of Christ, and a partaker also of the glory that is to be revealed:
60_5_2: Shepherd the flock of God among you — exercising oversight, not under compulsion but voluntarily, according to the will of God; nor for sordid gain, but with eagerness;
60_5_3: nor as lording it over those allotted to your charge, but as examples to the flock.
60_5_4: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.
60_5_5: Likewise, you younger men — be subject to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another — for "God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble."
60_5_6: Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God — that He may exalt you at the proper time.
60_5_7: Casting all your anxieties on Him, because He cares for you.
60_5_8: Be sober-minded. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
60_5_9: Resist him — firm in your faith — knowing that the same kinds of suffering are being accomplished by your brothers who are in the world.
60_5_10: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace — who called you to His eternal glory in Christ — will Himself perfect, confirm, strengthen, and establish you.
60_5_11: To Him be dominion forever and ever. Amen.
60_5_12: By Silvanus — our faithful brother, as I regard him — I have written to you briefly, exhorting and bearing witness that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
60_5_13: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings — and so does Mark, my son.
60_5_14: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ.
66_1_1: The Revelation of Jesus Christ — which God gave Him to show to His bondservants the things that must shortly take place. He made it known by sending it through His angel to His bondservant John,
66_1_2: who bore witness to the word of God and to the testimony of Jesus Christ — to all that he saw.
66_1_3: Blessed is the one who reads, and those who hear the words of this prophecy and keep what is written in it — for the time is near.
66_1_4: John — to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you, and peace, from Him who is, and who was, and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before His throne;
66_1_5: and from Jesus Christ — the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and freed us from our sins by His blood —
66_1_6: and made us a kingdom, priests to His God and Father — to Him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
66_1_7: Behold, He is coming with the clouds — and every eye will see Him, including those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn over Him. Yes, Amen.
66_1_8: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, "who is, and who was, and who is to come — the Almighty."
66_1_9: I, John — your brother and fellow partaker in the tribulation, kingdom, and steadfast endurance which are in Jesus — was on the island called Patmos, because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
66_1_10: I came to be in the Spirit on the Lord's day — and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet,
66_1_11: saying, "Write what you see in a scroll, and send it to the seven churches — to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."
66_1_12: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands —
66_1_13: and in the midst of the lampstands, One like a Son of Man — clothed in a robe down to His feet, and girded around the chest with a golden sash.
66_1_14: His head and His hair were white like wool, white as snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.
66_1_15: His feet were like burnished bronze, refined as in a furnace. And His voice was like the sound of many waters.
66_1_16: He had in His right hand seven stars, and out of His mouth came a sharp two-edged sword. And His face was like the sun shining in its strength.
66_1_17: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet as one dead. And He laid His right hand on me, saying, "Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
66_1_18: and the Living One. I was dead — and behold, I am alive forevermore. And I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
66_1_19: Therefore, write the things you have seen, and the things that are, and the things that shall take place after these.
66_1_20: As for the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand, and of the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches."
66_2_1: "To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven stars in His right hand — the One who walks in the midst of the seven golden lampstands:
66_2_2: I know your deeds, your toil, and your steadfastness — and that you cannot tolerate evil men. You have tested those who call themselves apostles and are not, and have found them to be false.
66_2_3: And you have steadfastness, and have endured for My name's sake, and have not grown weary.
66_2_4: But I have this against you: that you have left your first love.
66_2_5: Therefore, remember from where you have fallen — and repent, and do the deeds you did at first. Otherwise, I am coming to you, and I will remove your lampstand out of its place — unless you repent.
66_2_6: But you have this in your favor: that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
66_2_7: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches: To the one who overcomes, I will grant to eat of the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God."
66_2_8: "And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last — the One who was dead, and has come to life:
66_2_9: I know your tribulation and your poverty (yet you are rich) — and the slander of those who say they are Jews, and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
66_2_10: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, so that you may be tested. And you will have tribulation for ten days. Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
66_2_11: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches: The one who overcomes will not be hurt at all by the second death."
66_2_12: "And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of the One who has the sharp two-edged sword:
66_2_13: I know where you live — where Satan's throne is. And you hold fast to My name, and did not deny My faith — even in the days of Antipas, My faithful witness, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
66_2_14: But I have a few things against you: you have there those who hold to the teaching of Balaam — who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to commit sexual immorality.
66_2_15: So you also have those who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans, in the same way.
66_2_16: Therefore repent — or else I am coming to you quickly, and I will wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
66_2_17: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches: To the one who overcomes, I will give some of the hidden manna. And I will give him a white stone — and on the stone, a new name written, which no one knows but the one who receives it."
66_2_18: "And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God — whose eyes are like a flame of fire, and whose feet are like burnished bronze:
66_2_19: I know your deeds — your love, faith, service, and steadfastness — and that your latest deeds are greater than the first.
66_2_20: But I have this against you: that you tolerate the woman Jezebel — who calls herself a prophetess and teaches and seduces My bondservants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
66_2_21: I gave her time to repent — and she does not want to repent of her immorality.
66_2_22: Behold, I am throwing her on a sickbed — and those who commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of her deeds.
66_2_23: And I will kill her children with pestilence. Then all the churches will know that I am the One who searches the minds and hearts — and I will give to each of you according to your deeds.
66_2_24: But to you I say — to the rest in Thyatira who do not hold to this teaching, who have not learned 'the deep things of Satan,' as they call them — I am laying no other burden on you;
66_2_25: only hold fast to what you have, until I come.
66_2_26: And the one who overcomes, and who keeps My deeds until the end — to him I will give authority over the nations.
66_2_27: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron — as vessels of pottery are shattered — just as I also have received from My Father.
66_2_28: And I will give him the morning star.
66_2_29: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."
66_3_1: "And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I know your deeds — that you have a name that you are alive, but you are dead.
66_3_2: Be watchful — and strengthen the things that remain, which were about to die. For I have not found your deeds completed in the sight of My God.
66_3_3: Therefore, remember what you have received and heard — and keep it, and repent. Therefore, if you do not watch, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I will come upon you.
66_3_4: Yet you have a few names in Sardis who have not soiled their garments. They will walk with Me in white, because they are worthy.
66_3_5: The one who overcomes will be clothed in white garments. And I will not erase his name from the Book of Life — and I will confess his name before My Father and before His angels.
66_3_6: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."
66_3_7: "And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of the Holy One, the True One — who has the key of David, who opens and no one will shut, and who shuts and no one opens:
66_3_8: I know your deeds. Behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one is able to shut. For you have a little power, and have kept My word, and have not denied My name.
66_3_9: Behold, I will cause those of the synagogue of Satan — who say they are Jews and are not, but lie — behold, I will make them to come and bow down at your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
66_3_10: Because you have kept the word of My patient endurance, I also will keep you from the hour of testing — that hour which is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
66_3_11: I am coming quickly. Hold fast what you have, so that no one may take your crown.
66_3_12: The one who overcomes — I will make him a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will not go out from it anymore. And I will write on him the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God — the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from My God — and My new name.
66_3_13: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."
66_3_14: "And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen — the faithful and true Witness, the Beginning of God's creation:
66_3_15: I know your deeds — that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
66_3_16: So because you are lukewarm — and neither hot nor cold — I am about to spit you out of My mouth.
66_3_17: Because you say, 'I am rich, and have prospered, and have need of nothing' — and do not know that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked —
66_3_18: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire, that you may be rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
66_3_19: Those whom I love, I rebuke and discipline. Therefore, be zealous and repent.
66_3_20: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him, and dine with him — and he with Me.
66_3_21: The one who overcomes — I will grant to him to sit with Me on My throne, just as I also overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
66_3_22: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."
66_4_1: After these things I looked — and behold, a door standing open in heaven. And the first voice I had heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, said, "Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after these things."
66_4_2: Immediately I was in the Spirit — and behold, a throne stood in heaven, and One sitting on the throne.
66_4_3: And the One sitting there had the appearance of jasper and carnelian. And a rainbow encircled the throne, like an emerald in appearance.
66_4_4: Around the throne were twenty-four other thrones — and on the thrones I saw twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white garments, with golden crowns on their heads.
66_4_5: Out of the throne came flashes of lightning and rumblings and peals of thunder. And before the throne were burning seven lamps of fire — which are the seven Spirits of God.
66_4_6: And before the throne was, as it were, a sea of glass — like crystal. And in the midst of the throne, and around the throne, were four living creatures full of eyes in front and behind.
66_4_7: The first living creature was like a lion. The second living creature was like a calf. The third living creature had a face like a man. And the fourth living creature was like a flying eagle.
66_4_8: And the four living creatures, each having six wings, were full of eyes around and within. And they have no rest, day or night, saying: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty — who was, and who is, and who is to come!"
66_4_9: And whenever the living creatures give glory and honor and thanks to the One sitting on the throne — the One who lives forever and ever —
66_4_10: the twenty-four elders fall down before the One sitting on the throne, and worship the One who lives forever and ever. And they cast their crowns before the throne, saying:
66_4_11: "Worthy are You, our Lord and our God, to receive the glory, and the honor, and the power — for You created all things, and on account of Your will they existed and were created."
66_5_1: And I saw in the right hand of the One sitting on the throne a scroll written within and on the back, sealed up with seven seals.
66_5_2: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice: "Who is worthy to open the scroll and to break its seals?"
66_5_3: And no one in heaven, nor on earth, nor under the earth, was able to open the scroll or to look into it.
66_5_4: And I began to weep greatly, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or to look into it.
66_5_5: And one of the elders said to me, "Stop weeping. Behold, the Lion that is from the tribe of Judah — the Root of David — has overcome, so as to open the scroll and its seven seals."
66_5_6: And I saw, in the midst of the throne and the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing — as if slain — having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
66_5_7: And He came and took the scroll out of the right hand of the One sitting on the throne.
66_5_8: And when He took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each having a harp and golden bowls full of incense — which are the prayers of the saints.
66_5_9: And they sang a new song, saying: "Worthy are You to take the scroll and to break its seals — for You were slain, and You purchased for God by Your blood people from every tribe, tongue, people, and nation.
66_5_10: And You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to our God; and they will reign on the earth."
66_5_11: And I looked, and I heard the voice of many angels around the throne, and the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was myriads of myriads, and thousands of thousands —
66_5_12: saying with a loud voice: "Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive the power, and riches, and wisdom, and might, and honor, and glory, and blessing!"
66_5_13: And every created thing that is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and on the sea, and all things in them — I heard them saying: "To the One sitting on the throne, and to the Lamb, be the blessing, and the honor, and the glory, and the dominion forever and ever."
66_5_14: And the four living creatures kept saying, "Amen." And the elders fell down and worshiped.
66_6_1: And I saw when the Lamb broke one of the seven seals — and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, "Come!"
66_6_2: And I looked, and behold, a white horse — and the one sitting on it had a bow. And a crown was given to him, and he went out conquering and to conquer.
66_6_3: And when He broke the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, "Come!"
66_6_4: And another, a fiery red horse, came out. And to the one sitting on it, it was granted to take peace from the earth, and that men would slaughter one another. And a great sword was given to him.
66_6_5: And when He broke the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, "Come!" And I looked, and behold, a black horse — and the one sitting on it had a pair of scales in his hand.
66_6_6: And I heard, as it were, a voice in the midst of the four living creatures, saying: "A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius — and do not damage the oil and the wine!"
66_6_7: And when He broke the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, "Come!"
66_6_8: And I looked, and behold, a pale-green horse. The one sitting on it — his name was Death, and Hades was following with him. And authority was given to them over a fourth of the earth — to kill with sword, and with famine, and with plague, and by the wild beasts of the earth.
66_6_9: And when He broke the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been slain because of the word of God and because of the testimony they had maintained.
66_6_10: And they cried out with a loud voice, saying, "How long, O Master — holy and true — until You judge and avenge our blood from those who dwell on the earth?"
66_6_11: And there was given to each of them a white robe — and they were told to rest yet a little while longer, until the number of their fellow servants and of their brothers — who were about to be killed even as they had been — would be completed.
66_6_12: And I saw when He broke the sixth seal — and there was a great earthquake. And the sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became like blood,
66_6_13: and the stars of heaven fell to the earth, as a fig tree drops its unripe figs when shaken by a great wind.
66_6_14: And the sky was split apart, like a scroll being rolled up. And every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
66_6_15: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the commanders, and the rich, and the strong, and every slave and free man — hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
66_6_16: And they said to the mountains and to the rocks: "Fall on us! And hide us from the face of the One sitting on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb!
66_6_17: For the great day of Their wrath has come — and who is able to stand?"
66_7_1: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth — holding back the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.
66_7_2: And I saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, having the seal of the living God. And he cried out with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it had been granted to harm the earth and the sea,
66_7_3: saying, "Do not harm the earth, the sea, or the trees — until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads."
66_7_4: And I heard the number of those who were sealed: a hundred and forty-four thousand sealed — from every tribe of the sons of Israel.
66_7_5: From the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand were sealed; from the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand;
66_7_6: from the tribe of Asher, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Naphtali, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand;
66_7_7: from the tribe of Simeon, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand;
66_7_8: from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Joseph, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand were sealed.
66_7_9: After these things I looked — and behold, a great multitude that no one could number, from every nation and all tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were clothed in white robes, and palm branches were in their hands.
66_7_10: And they cry out with a loud voice, saying: "Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!"
66_7_11: And all the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. And they fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
66_7_12: saying: "Amen! The blessing, and the glory, and the wisdom, and the thanksgiving, and the honor, and the power, and the might, be to our God forever and ever. Amen."
66_7_13: And one of the elders responded — saying to me, "These who are clothed in the white robes — who are they, and where have they come from?"
66_7_14: And I said to him, "My lord, you know." And he said to me, "These are the ones who come out of the great tribulation. And they have washed their robes, and made them white, in the blood of the Lamb.
66_7_15: For this reason, they are before the throne of God — and they serve Him day and night in His temple. And the One sitting on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
66_7_16: They will hunger no more, neither thirst anymore. The sun will not strike them, nor any heat —
66_7_17: for the Lamb in the midst of the throne will shepherd them, and will lead them to springs of the waters of life. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."
66_8_1: And when He broke the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
66_8_2: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God — and seven trumpets were given to them.
66_8_3: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer. And much incense was given to him, so that he might add it to the prayers of all the saints — on the golden altar that is before the throne.
66_8_4: And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel's hand.
66_8_5: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with the fire of the altar, and threw it to the earth. And there were peals of thunder and rumblings and flashes of lightning and an earthquake.
66_8_6: And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound them.
66_8_7: The first sounded — and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. And a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.
66_8_8: And the second angel sounded — and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. And a third of the sea became blood;
66_8_9: and a third of the creatures in the sea — those that had life — died; and a third of the ships were destroyed.
66_8_10: And the third angel sounded — and a great star fell from heaven, blazing like a torch. And it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of waters.
66_8_11: And the name of the star is called Wormwood. And a third of the waters became wormwood — and many people died from the waters, because they had been made bitter.
66_8_12: And the fourth angel sounded — and a third of the sun was struck, and a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them was darkened. And the day did not shine for a third of it — and the night likewise.
66_8_13: And I looked, and I heard an eagle flying in midheaven, saying with a loud voice: "Woe, woe, woe to those who dwell on the earth — because of the remaining trumpet blasts of the three angels who are about to sound!"
66_9_1: And the fifth angel sounded — and I saw a star from heaven that had fallen to the earth. And the key of the shaft of the abyss was given to him.
66_9_2: And he opened the shaft of the abyss — and smoke went up out of the shaft, like the smoke of a great furnace. And the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke of the shaft.
66_9_3: And out of the smoke came forth locusts on the earth — and authority was given to them, like the authority of scorpions of the earth.
66_9_4: And they were told not to harm the grass of the earth, nor any green plant, nor any tree — but only the men who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
66_9_5: And it was given to them not to kill them — but to torment them for five months. And their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it stings a man.
66_9_6: And in those days, men will seek death and will not find it. They will long to die — and death will flee from them.
66_9_7: And the appearance of the locusts was like horses prepared for battle. And on their heads were what looked like crowns of gold, and their faces were like the faces of men.
66_9_8: And they had hair like the hair of women — and their teeth were like the teeth of lions.
66_9_9: And they had breastplates like breastplates of iron — and the sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots, of many horses rushing into battle.
66_9_10: And they had tails like scorpions, and stings — and in their tails was their authority to harm men for five months.
66_9_11: They have over them a king — the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek he has the name Apollyon.
66_9_12: The first woe is past. Behold, two more woes are still coming after these things.
66_9_13: And the sixth angel sounded — and I heard a single voice from the four horns of the golden altar that is before God,
66_9_14: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."
66_9_15: And the four angels were released — those who had been prepared for the hour and day and month and year — to kill a third of mankind.
66_9_16: And the number of the troops of the cavalry was two hundred million. I heard their number.
66_9_17: And this is how I saw the horses in the vision, and those sitting on them: they had breastplates the color of fire, and of hyacinth, and of brimstone. And the heads of the horses were like the heads of lions — and out of their mouths proceeded fire and smoke and brimstone.
66_9_18: By these three plagues, a third of mankind was killed — by the fire and the smoke and the brimstone that came out of their mouths.
66_9_19: For the authority of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails — for their tails are like serpents, having heads, and with them they do harm.
66_9_20: And the rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands — that they should not worship demons and the idols of gold and silver and bronze and stone and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk.
66_9_21: And they did not repent of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their immorality, nor of their thefts.
66_10_1: And I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven — clothed with a cloud, and a rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
66_10_2: And he had in his hand a little scroll, opened. And he placed his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land —
66_10_3: and he cried out with a loud voice, like the roaring of a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
66_10_4: And when the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to write — and I heard a voice from heaven saying, "Seal up the things which the seven thunders have spoken — and do not write them."
66_10_5: And the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven,
66_10_6: and swore by the One who lives forever and ever — who created heaven and the things in it, and the earth and the things in it, and the sea and the things in it — that there will be delay no longer.
66_10_7: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished — as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.
66_10_8: And the voice that I heard from heaven, I heard again, speaking to me — and saying, "Go, take the scroll that is open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land."
66_10_9: And I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little scroll. And he said to me, "Take it and eat it — and it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey."
66_10_10: And I took the little scroll out of the angel's hand, and ate it. And in my mouth it was sweet as honey — but when I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
66_10_11: And he said to me, "You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings."
66_11_1: And there was given to me a measuring rod, like a staff. And he said, "Get up and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and those who worship in it.
66_11_2: But the court that is outside the temple, leave it out — and do not measure it. For it has been given to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for forty-two months.
66_11_3: And I will give authority to My two witnesses — and they will prophesy for one thousand two hundred and sixty days, clothed in sackcloth."
66_11_4: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
66_11_5: And if anyone wants to harm them, fire flows out of their mouth and devours their enemies — and if anyone wants to harm them, in this manner he must be killed.
66_11_6: These have authority to shut up the sky, so that rain does not fall during the days of their prophesying. And they have authority over the waters, to turn them into blood — and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.
66_11_7: And when they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them — and will overcome them and kill them.
66_11_8: And their dead bodies will lie in the street of the great city — which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt — where also their Lord was crucified.
66_11_9: And those from the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations look at their dead bodies for three and a half days. And they do not permit their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.
66_11_10: And those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them and celebrate — and they will send gifts to one another, because these two prophets had tormented those who dwell on the earth.
66_11_11: And after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God came into them — and they stood on their feet. And great fear fell upon those who saw them.
66_11_12: And they heard a loud voice from heaven, saying to them, "Come up here." And they went up into heaven in the cloud — and their enemies watched them.
66_11_13: And in that hour there was a great earthquake — and a tenth of the city fell. And seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake. And the rest were terrified, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
66_11_14: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe is coming quickly.
66_11_15: And the seventh angel sounded — and there were loud voices in heaven, saying: "The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ — and He will reign forever and ever."
66_11_16: And the twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,
66_11_17: saying: "We give You thanks, O Lord God Almighty — the One who is and who was — because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.
66_11_18: And the nations were enraged — and Your wrath came, and the time came for the dead to be judged, and to give the reward to Your bondservants the prophets, and to the saints, and to those who fear Your name — the small and the great — and to destroy those who destroy the earth."
66_11_19: And the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant was seen in His temple. And there were flashes of lightning and rumblings and peals of thunder and an earthquake and great hail.
66_12_1: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet — and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
66_12_2: And she was with child — and she cried out in birth pains and in agony to give birth.
66_12_3: And another sign appeared in heaven — and behold, a great fiery red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads were seven diadems.
66_12_4: And his tail swept away a third of the stars of heaven — and threw them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.
66_12_5: And she gave birth to a son — a male child — who is going to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. And her child was caught up to God and to His throne.
66_12_6: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God — so that there they would feed her for one thousand two hundred and sixty days.
66_12_7: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels waging war with the dragon. And the dragon and his angels waged war —
66_12_8: and they did not prevail, nor was a place found for them any longer in heaven.
66_12_9: And the great dragon was thrown down — that ancient serpent, who is called the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited world. He was thrown down to the earth — and his angels were thrown down with him.
66_12_10: And I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying: "Now have come the salvation, and the power, and the kingdom of our God — and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down — the one who accuses them before our God day and night.
66_12_11: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony — and they did not love their lives, even unto death.
66_12_12: Therefore rejoice, O heavens — and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and the sea — for the devil has come down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has only a short time."
66_12_13: And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who had given birth to the male child.
66_12_14: And the two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman — so that she could fly into the wilderness to her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, away from the presence of the serpent.
66_12_15: And the serpent poured out of his mouth water like a river after the woman — so that he might cause her to be swept away with the flood.
66_12_16: And the earth came to the help of the woman: the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river that the dragon had poured out of his mouth.
66_12_17: And the dragon was enraged at the woman — and went off to make war with the rest of her offspring: those who keep the commandments of God, and hold the testimony of Jesus.
66_13_1: And he stood on the sand of the sea. And I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. And on his horns were ten diadems, and on his heads were blasphemous names.
66_13_2: And the beast that I saw was like a leopard. His feet were like the feet of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave to him his power, and his throne, and great authority.
66_13_3: And one of his heads appeared as if it had been slain to death — but his fatal wound was healed. And the whole earth marveled and followed after the beast.
66_13_4: And they worshiped the dragon because he gave authority to the beast. And they worshiped the beast, saying, "Who is like the beast? And who is able to wage war with him?"
66_13_5: And there was given to him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies. And authority was given to him to act for forty-two months.
66_13_6: And he opened his mouth in blasphemies against God — to blaspheme His name and His tabernacle, and those who dwell in heaven.
66_13_7: And it was given to him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them. And authority was given to him over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
66_13_8: And all who dwell on the earth will worship him — everyone whose name has not been written, from the foundation of the world, in the Book of Life of the Lamb who has been slain.
66_13_9: If anyone has an ear, let him hear:
66_13_10: If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he goes. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, with the sword he must be killed. Here is the steadfastness and the faith of the saints.
66_13_11: And I saw another beast coming up out of the earth — and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke like a dragon.
66_13_12: And he exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. And he makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast — whose fatal wound was healed.
66_13_13: And he performs great signs — even making fire come down out of heaven to the earth in the sight of men.
66_13_14: And he deceives those who dwell on the earth, because of the signs which it was given to him to perform in the presence of the beast — telling those who dwell on the earth to make an image to the beast who had the wound of the sword and yet lived.
66_13_15: And it was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast — so that the image of the beast would even speak, and would cause as many as do not worship the image of the beast to be killed.
66_13_16: And he causes all — the small and the great, and the rich and the poor, and the free and the slaves — to be given a mark on their right hand, or on their forehead;
66_13_17: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell, except the one who has the mark — either the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
66_13_18: Here is wisdom: let the one who has understanding calculate the number of the beast — for the number is that of a man, and his number is six hundred and sixty-six.
66_14_1: And I looked, and behold, the Lamb was standing on Mount Zion — and with Him a hundred and forty-four thousand, having His name and the name of His Father written on their foreheads.
66_14_2: And I heard a voice from heaven, like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of loud thunder. And the voice I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.
66_14_3: And they sing, as it were, a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. And no one could learn the song except the hundred and forty-four thousand who had been redeemed from the earth.
66_14_4: These are the ones who have not been defiled with women — for they are virgins. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever He goes. These have been redeemed from among men — firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.
66_14_5: And in their mouth no lie was found. They are blameless.
66_14_6: And I saw another angel flying in midheaven, having an eternal gospel to preach to those who live on the earth — and to every nation and tribe and tongue and people —
66_14_7: saying with a loud voice: "Fear God, and give Him glory — for the hour of His judgment has come. And worship the One who made the heaven, and the earth, and the sea, and the springs of waters."
66_14_8: And another, a second angel, followed — saying, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great — she who has made all the nations drink of the wine of the passion of her immorality."
66_14_9: And another, a third angel, followed them — saying with a loud voice, "If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,
66_14_10: he himself also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God — which is mixed full strength in the cup of His anger. And he will be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
66_14_11: And the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. And they have no rest day and night — those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name."
66_14_12: Here is the steadfastness of the saints — those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
66_14_13: And I heard a voice from heaven, saying, "Write: 'Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.' " "Yes," says the Spirit, "so that they may rest from their labors — for their works follow with them."
66_14_14: And I looked, and behold, a white cloud — and on the cloud was sitting One like a Son of Man, having on His head a golden crown, and in His hand a sharp sickle.
66_14_15: And another angel came out of the temple, calling out with a loud voice to the One sitting on the cloud: "Send Your sickle, and reap — for the hour to reap has come, because the harvest of the earth is ripe."
66_14_16: And the One sitting on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth — and the earth was reaped.
66_14_17: And another angel came out of the temple in heaven — also having a sharp sickle.
66_14_18: And another angel came out of the altar — the one who has authority over the fire — and he called out with a loud voice to the one who had the sharp sickle, saying, "Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth — for her grapes are ripe."
66_14_19: And the angel swung his sickle to the earth, and gathered the clusters from the vine of the earth — and threw them into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
66_14_20: And the winepress was trodden outside the city. And blood came out of the winepress, up to the bridles of the horses, for a distance of about two hundred miles.
66_15_1: And I saw another sign in heaven — great and marvelous: seven angels having seven plagues, the last ones — for in them the wrath of God is finished.
66_15_2: And I saw, as it were, a sea of glass mixed with fire — and those who came off victorious from the beast and from his image and from the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, holding harps of God.
66_15_3: And they sing the song of Moses, the bondservant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying: "Great and marvelous are Your works, O Lord God, the Almighty. Righteous and true are Your ways, O King of the nations.
66_15_4: Who will not fear, O Lord — and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before You — for Your righteous acts have been revealed."
66_15_5: And after these things I looked — and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
66_15_6: And out of the temple came the seven angels who had the seven plagues — clothed in clean, bright linen, and girded around their chests with golden sashes.
66_15_7: And one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls, full of the wrath of God — who lives forever and ever.
66_15_8: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power. And no one was able to enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished.
66_16_1: And I heard a loud voice from the temple, saying to the seven angels, "Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth."
66_16_2: And the first one went and poured out his bowl on the earth. And it became a foul and malignant sore on the people who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped his image.
66_16_3: And the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea — and it became blood like that of a dead man. And every living thing in the sea died.
66_16_4: And the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and the springs of waters — and they became blood.
66_16_5: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, "Righteous are You — the One who is, and the One who was, the Holy One — because You judged these things.
66_16_6: For they poured out the blood of the saints and the prophets — and You have given them blood to drink. They deserve it."
66_16_7: And I heard the altar saying, "Yes, O Lord God, the Almighty — Your judgments are true and righteous."
66_16_8: And the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun — and it was given to it to scorch men with fire.
66_16_9: And the men were scorched with fierce heat. And they blasphemed the name of God, who has authority over these plagues — and they did not repent so as to give Him glory.
66_16_10: And the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast — and his kingdom became darkened. And they were gnawing their tongues from pain,
66_16_11: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores — and they did not repent of their deeds.
66_16_12: And the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates — and its water was dried up, so that the way might be prepared for the kings from the east.
66_16_13: And I saw three unclean spirits, like frogs, coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
66_16_14: For they are spirits of demons, performing signs — which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited world, to gather them together for the war of the great day of God Almighty.
66_16_15: ("Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps his garments — so that he will not walk about naked, and they see his shame.")
66_16_16: And they gathered them together to the place that in Hebrew is called Har-Magedon.
66_16_17: And the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air — and a loud voice came out of the temple from the throne, saying, "It is done."
66_16_18: And there were flashes of lightning and rumblings and peals of thunder. And there was a great earthquake — such as had not occurred since man came to be on the earth, so great an earthquake was it, and so mighty.
66_16_19: And the great city was split into three parts — and the cities of the nations fell. And Babylon the great was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of His wrath.
66_16_20: And every island fled away — and the mountains were not found.
66_16_21: And huge hailstones, about a hundred pounds each, came down from heaven upon men. And the men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail — for the plague was extremely severe.
66_17_1: And one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, "Come — I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,
66_17_2: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality — and those who dwell on the earth were made drunk with the wine of her immorality."
66_17_3: And he carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. And I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast — full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.
66_17_4: And the woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold, and precious stones, and pearls — having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the unclean things of her sexual immorality.
66_17_5: And on her forehead was a name written: a mystery — "Babylon the Great, the Mother of Prostitutes and of the Abominations of the Earth."
66_17_6: And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. And when I saw her, I marveled with great amazement.
66_17_7: And the angel said to me, "Why did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carries her — the one having the seven heads and the ten horns.
66_17_8: The beast that you saw was, and is not — and is about to come up out of the abyss, and is going to destruction. And those who dwell on the earth — whose names have not been written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world — will marvel when they see the beast: that he was, and is not, and shall come.
66_17_9: Here is the mind which has wisdom: the seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
66_17_10: And they are seven kings — five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come. And when he comes, he must remain a little while.
66_17_11: And the beast that was, and is not — he himself is also an eighth, and is one of the seven, and he goes to destruction.
66_17_12: And the ten horns that you saw are ten kings, who have not yet received a kingdom — but they receive authority as kings, with the beast, for one hour.
66_17_13: These have one mind — and they give their power and authority to the beast.
66_17_14: These will wage war with the Lamb — and the Lamb will overcome them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings. And those who are with Him are the called and chosen and faithful."
66_17_15: And he said to me, "The waters that you saw — where the prostitute sits — are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.
66_17_16: And the ten horns that you saw, and the beast — these will hate the prostitute. And they will make her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh, and will burn her up with fire.
66_17_17: For God put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose — to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
66_17_18: And the woman whom you saw is the great city — which has a kingdom over the kings of the earth."
66_18_1: After these things I saw another angel coming down out of heaven, having great authority. And the earth was illumined with his glory.
66_18_2: And he cried out with a mighty voice, saying: "Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a dwelling place of demons — a haunt of every unclean spirit, and a haunt of every unclean and hateful bird.
66_18_3: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the passion of her immorality. And the kings of the earth have committed immorality with her — and the merchants of the earth have become rich by the wealth of her sensuality."
66_18_4: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying: "Come out of her, My people — so that you will not share in her sins, and so that you will not receive of her plagues.
66_18_5: For her sins have piled up as high as heaven — and God has remembered her iniquities.
66_18_6: Pay her back even as she has paid — and give back to her double according to her deeds. In the cup which she has mixed, mix twice as much for her.
66_18_7: To the degree that she glorified herself and lived sensuously, to that degree give her torment and mourning. For in her heart she says, 'I sit as a queen — I am no widow, and I will never see mourning.'
66_18_8: Therefore in one day her plagues will come — pestilence and mourning and famine. And she will be burned up with fire — for the Lord God who judges her is strong."
66_18_9: And the kings of the earth — who committed immorality with her, and lived sensuously with her — will weep and lament for her, when they see the smoke of her burning.
66_18_10: Standing far off because of the fear of her torment, they say, "Woe, woe — the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For in one hour your judgment has come."
66_18_11: And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn for her, because no one buys their cargoes anymore —
66_18_12: cargoes of gold and silver and precious stones and pearls; of fine linen and purple and silk and scarlet; every kind of citron wood, every article of ivory, every article of most precious wood and bronze and iron and marble;
66_18_13: and cinnamon and spice and incense and myrrh and frankincense; and wine and olive oil and fine flour and wheat; and cattle and sheep, horses and chariots — and slaves, and the souls of men.
66_18_14: "And the fruit you long for has gone from you. All things that were luxurious and splendid have passed away from you — and people will no longer find them."
66_18_15: The merchants of these things — who became rich from her — will stand far off, because of the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,
66_18_16: saying, "Woe, woe — the great city, clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls!
66_18_17: For in one hour such great wealth has been laid waste!" And every shipmaster, and every passenger and sailor, and as many as make their living by the sea, stood far off.
66_18_18: And they were crying out as they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, "What city is like the great city?"
66_18_19: And they threw dust on their heads, and were crying out, weeping and mourning, saying, "Woe, woe — the great city, by which all who had ships at sea became rich by her wealth! For in one hour she has been laid waste!"
66_18_20: Rejoice over her, O heaven — and you saints and apostles and prophets — because God has pronounced your judgment against her.
66_18_21: And a strong angel took up a stone like a great millstone — and threw it into the sea, saying: "In this way Babylon, the great city, will be thrown down with violence — and will not be found any longer.
66_18_22: And the sound of harpists and musicians and flute-players and trumpeters will not be heard in you any longer. And no craftsman of any craft will be found in you any longer. And the sound of a mill will not be heard in you any longer.
66_18_23: And the light of a lamp will not shine in you any longer. And the voice of bridegroom and bride will not be heard in you any longer — because your merchants were the great men of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your sorcery.
66_18_24: And in her was found the blood of prophets and of saints — and of all who have been slain on the earth."
66_19_1: After these things I heard, as it were, a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying: "Hallelujah! The salvation, and the glory, and the power belong to our God —
66_19_2: for true and righteous are His judgments. For He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality — and He has avenged the blood of His bondservants on her."
66_19_3: And a second time they said, "Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever."
66_19_4: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, "Amen — Hallelujah!"
66_19_5: And a voice came from the throne, saying, "Give praise to our God, all you His bondservants — those who fear Him, the small and the great."
66_19_6: And I heard, as it were, the voice of a great multitude, and like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of mighty peals of thunder, saying: "Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, has begun to reign.
66_19_7: Let us rejoice and be glad and give the glory to Him — for the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.
66_19_8: And it was given to her to be clothed in fine linen, bright and clean — for the fine linen is the righteous deeds of the saints."
66_19_9: And he said to me, "Write: Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb." And he said to me, "These are the true words of God."
66_19_10: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said to me, "See that you do not do that. I am a fellow servant of yours, and of your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God. For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."
66_19_11: And I saw heaven opened — and behold, a white horse. And the One sitting on it is called Faithful and True. And in righteousness He judges and wages war.
66_19_12: And His eyes are a flame of fire. And on His head are many diadems. And He has a name written on Him which no one knows except Himself.
66_19_13: And He is clothed in a robe dipped in blood — and His name is called The Word of God.
66_19_14: And the armies which are in heaven were following Him on white horses — clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
66_19_15: And out of His mouth comes a sharp sword — so that with it He may strike down the nations. And He will rule them with a rod of iron — and He treads the winepress of the fierce wrath of God, the Almighty.
66_19_16: And on His robe and on His thigh He has a name written: "KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS."
66_19_17: And I saw an angel standing in the sun. And he cried out with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in midheaven: "Come, gather together for the great supper of God —
66_19_18: so that you may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of commanders, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and those sitting on them — and the flesh of all men, both free men and slaves, both small and great."
66_19_19: And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies, gathered together to wage war against the One sitting on the horse, and against His army.
66_19_20: And the beast was seized — and with him the false prophet who performed the signs in his presence, by which he had deceived those who received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. The two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with brimstone.
66_19_21: And the rest were killed by the sword which proceeded from the mouth of the One sitting on the horse — and all the birds were filled with their flesh.
66_20_1: And I saw an angel coming down from heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
66_20_2: And he laid hold of the dragon — that ancient serpent, who is the devil and Satan — and bound him for a thousand years.
66_20_3: And he threw him into the abyss, and shut it, and sealed it over him — so that he should deceive the nations no longer, until the thousand years were completed. After these things he must be released for a short time.
66_20_4: And I saw thrones, and they sat on them — and judgment was given to them. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God — those who had not worshiped the beast or his image, and had not received the mark on their forehead and on their hand. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
66_20_5: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.
66_20_6: Blessed and holy is the one who has a part in the first resurrection. Over these the second death has no authority — but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with Him for a thousand years.
66_20_7: And when the thousand years are completed, Satan will be released from his prison.
66_20_8: And he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth — Gog and Magog — to gather them together for the war. The number of them is as the sand of the seashore.
66_20_9: And they came up over the breadth of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. And fire came down from heaven and devoured them.
66_20_10: And the devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and brimstone — where the beast and the false prophet are also. And they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
66_20_11: And I saw a great white throne, and the One sitting on it — from whose presence earth and heaven fled away, and no place was found for them.
66_20_12: And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne. And books were opened — and another book was opened, which is the Book of Life. And the dead were judged from the things written in the books, according to their deeds.
66_20_13: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it, and Death and Hades gave up the dead which were in them. And they were judged, each one of them, according to their deeds.
66_20_14: And Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death — the lake of fire.
66_20_15: And if anyone's name was not found written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
66_21_1: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth — for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and there is no longer any sea.
66_21_2: And I saw the holy city — new Jerusalem — coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
66_21_3: And I heard a loud voice from the throne, saying, "Behold, the tabernacle of God is among men — and He will dwell among them. And they will be His peoples, and God Himself will be among them and be their God.
66_21_4: And He will wipe away every tear from their eyes — and there will no longer be any death; nor mourning, nor crying, nor pain. The first things have passed away."
66_21_5: And the One sitting on the throne said, "Behold, I am making all things new." And He said, "Write — for these words are faithful and true."
66_21_6: And He said to me, "It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega — the Beginning and the End. To the one who thirsts, I will give from the spring of the water of life freely.
66_21_7: The one who overcomes will inherit these things, and I will be his God — and he will be My son.
66_21_8: But for the cowardly, and unbelieving, and abominable, and murderers, and the sexually immoral, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars — their part will be in the lake that burns with fire and brimstone, which is the second death."
66_21_9: And one of the seven angels — those who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues — came and spoke with me, saying, "Come — I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb."
66_21_10: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain — and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
66_21_11: having the glory of God. Her brilliance was like a very precious stone — like a stone of crystal-clear jasper.
66_21_12: It had a great and high wall, with twelve gates — and at the gates twelve angels. And on the gates names were written, which are those of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel.
66_21_13: On the east, three gates; on the north, three gates; on the south, three gates; and on the west, three gates.
66_21_14: And the wall of the city had twelve foundation stones — and on them were the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
66_21_15: And the one who spoke with me had a measuring rod of gold — to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.
66_21_16: And the city is laid out as a square — and its length is as great as its width. And he measured the city with the rod, twelve thousand stadia. Its length and width and height are equal.
66_21_17: And he measured its wall — one hundred and forty-four cubits — by the measure of a man, which is also that of an angel.
66_21_18: And the material of its wall was jasper, and the city was pure gold — like clear glass.
66_21_19: The foundation stones of the wall of the city were adorned with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation stone was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;
66_21_20: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprase; the eleventh, jacinth; the twelfth, amethyst.
66_21_21: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls — each one of the gates was, separately, of one pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
66_21_22: And I saw no temple in it — for the Lord God, the Almighty, and the Lamb are its temple.
66_21_23: And the city has no need of the sun or of the moon to shine on it — for the glory of God has illumined it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
66_21_24: And the nations will walk by its light — and the kings of the earth will bring their glory into it.
66_21_25: And in the daytime — for there will be no night there — its gates will not be shut.
66_21_26: And they will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it.
66_21_27: And nothing unclean will ever enter it — nor anyone who practices abomination and lying — but only those whose names are written in the Lamb's Book of Life.
66_22_1: And he showed me a river of the water of life, clear as crystal — coming from the throne of God and of the Lamb,
66_22_2: in the middle of its street. And on either side of the river was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit every month. And the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
66_22_3: And there will no longer be any curse — and the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it. And His bondservants will serve Him.
66_22_4: And they will see His face — and His name will be on their foreheads.
66_22_5: And there will no longer be any night. And they will not have need of the light of a lamp, nor the light of the sun — because the Lord God will illumine them. And they will reign forever and ever.
66_22_6: And he said to me, "These words are faithful and true." And the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent His angel to show to His bondservants the things which must shortly take place.
66_22_7: "And behold, I am coming quickly. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book."
66_22_8: And I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed me these things.
66_22_9: And he said to me, "See that you do not do that. I am a fellow bondservant of yours, and of your brothers the prophets, and of those who keep the words of this book. Worship God."
66_22_10: And he said to me, "Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book — for the time is near.
66_22_11: Let the one who does wrong still do wrong — and let the one who is filthy still be filthy. And let the one who is righteous still practice righteousness — and let the one who is holy still keep himself holy."
66_22_12: "Behold, I am coming quickly — and My reward is with Me, to give to each one as his work is.
66_22_13: I am the Alpha and the Omega — the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
66_22_14: Blessed are those who wash their robes — so that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter by the gates into the city.
66_22_15: Outside are the dogs, and the sorcerers, and the sexually immoral, and the murderers, and the idolaters — and everyone who loves and practices a lie.
66_22_16: I, Jesus, have sent My angel to testify these things to you for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David — the bright morning star."
66_22_17: And the Spirit and the bride say, "Come." And let the one who hears say, "Come." And let the one who is thirsty come — and let the one who wishes take the water of life freely.
66_22_18: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues that are written in this book.
66_22_19: And if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life and from the holy city — those things which are written in this book.
66_22_20: The One who testifies to these things says, "Yes, I am coming quickly." Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
66_22_21: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.
59_1_1: James, a bondservant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ — to the twelve tribes scattered abroad: Greetings.
59_1_2: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, whenever you encounter trials of various kinds —
59_1_3: knowing that the testing of your faith produces steadfastness.
59_1_4: And let steadfastness have its full effect — so that you may be mature and complete, lacking in nothing.
59_1_5: If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God — who gives generously to all without reproach — and it will be given to him.
59_1_6: But let him ask in faith, doubting nothing — for the one who doubts is like the surf of the sea, driven and tossed by the wind.
59_1_7: That person should not expect to receive anything from the Lord —
59_1_8: he is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
59_1_9: But let the brother of humble circumstances boast in his exaltation,
59_1_10: and the rich man, in his humiliation — because like a flower of the grass, he will pass away.
59_1_11: For the sun rises with its scorching heat, and withers the grass — and its flower falls off, and the beauty of its appearance is destroyed. So also the rich man, in the midst of his pursuits, will fade away.
59_1_12: Blessed is the man who endures trial — for once he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to those who love Him.
59_1_13: Let no one say when he is tempted, "I am being tempted by God." For God cannot be tempted by evil, and He Himself tempts no one.
59_1_14: But each one is tempted, when he is dragged away and enticed by his own lust.
59_1_15: Then, when lust has conceived, it gives birth to sin — and sin, when it has run its course, brings forth death.
59_1_16: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.
59_1_17: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above — coming down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation, nor shifting shadow.
59_1_18: In the exercise of His will He brought us forth by the word of truth — so that we would be a kind of firstfruits among His creatures.
59_1_19: Know this, my beloved brothers: let everyone be quick to hear, slow to speak, slow to anger.
59_1_20: For the anger of man does not produce the righteousness of God.
59_1_21: Therefore, putting aside all filthiness and all the abundance of wickedness, in humility receive the implanted word — which is able to save your souls.
59_1_22: But be doers of the word, and not hearers only — deceiving yourselves.
59_1_23: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man who looks at his natural face in a mirror.
59_1_24: For he looks at himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
59_1_25: But the one who looks intently into the perfect law — the law of liberty — and continues in it, not having become a forgetful hearer but a doer of the work — this man will be blessed in what he does.
59_1_26: If anyone considers himself religious, and yet does not bridle his tongue, but deceives his own heart — this man's religion is worthless.
59_1_27: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their distress — and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
59_2_1: My brothers, do not hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with an attitude of partiality.
59_2_2: For if a man comes into your assembly with a gold ring and fine clothing — and a poor man also comes in dirty clothes —
59_2_3: and you pay special attention to the one wearing the fine clothing, and say, "You sit here in a good place," and to the poor one, "You stand there," or, "Sit down by my footstool" —
59_2_4: have you not made distinctions among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
59_2_5: Listen, my beloved brothers — did not God choose the poor of this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which He promised to those who love Him?
59_2_6: But you have dishonored the poor man. Is it not the rich who oppress you and personally drag you into court?
59_2_7: Do they not blaspheme the fair name by which you have been called?
59_2_8: If, however, you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself," you are doing well.
59_2_9: But if you show partiality, you are committing sin — and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
59_2_10: For whoever keeps the whole law and yet stumbles in one point — he has become guilty of all.
59_2_11: For He who said, "Do not commit adultery," also said, "Do not commit murder." Now if you do not commit adultery, but do commit murder — you have become a transgressor of the law.
59_2_12: So speak and so act, as those who are to be judged by the law of liberty.
59_2_13: For judgment will be merciless to one who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
59_2_14: What use is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith but he has no works? Can that faith save him?
59_2_15: If a brother or sister is without clothing and lacks the daily food,
59_2_16: and one of you says to them, "Go in peace, be warmed and be filled" — and yet you do not give them what is needed for the body — what use is that?
59_2_17: Even so, faith — if it has no works — is dead, being by itself.
59_2_18: But someone may well say, "You have faith, and I have works." Show me your faith without the works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
59_2_19: You believe that God is one. You do well — the demons also believe, and shudder.
59_2_20: But are you willing to recognize, you foolish man, that faith without works is useless?
59_2_21: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
59_2_22: You see that faith was working with his works — and as a result of the works, faith was made complete.
59_2_23: And the Scripture was fulfilled, which says, "And Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned to him as righteousness," and he was called the friend of God.
59_2_24: You see that a man is justified by works, and not by faith alone.
59_2_25: And in the same way, was not Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, when she received the messengers and sent them out by another way?
59_2_26: For just as the body without the spirit is dead, so also faith without works is dead.
59_3_1: Let not many of you become teachers, my brothers — knowing that as such we will incur a stricter judgment.
59_3_2: For we all stumble in many ways. If anyone does not stumble in word, he is a perfect man — able to bridle the whole body as well.
59_3_3: Now if we put the bits into the horses' mouths so that they will obey us, we direct their entire body as well.
59_3_4: Look at the ships also — though they are so large, and are driven by strong winds — they are turned by a very small rudder, wherever the inclination of the pilot desires.
59_3_5: So also the tongue is a small part of the body, and yet it boasts of great things. Behold, how great a forest is set ablaze by such a small fire!
59_3_6: And the tongue is a fire — the very world of iniquity. The tongue is set among our members as that which defiles the entire body, and sets on fire the course of our life — and is set on fire by hell.
59_3_7: For every species of beasts and birds, of reptiles and creatures of the sea, is tamed and has been tamed by the human race.
59_3_8: But no one among men can tame the tongue — it is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
59_3_9: With it we bless our Lord and Father — and with it we curse men, who have been made in the likeness of God.
59_3_10: From the same mouth come both blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be this way.
59_3_11: Does a fountain send out from the same opening both fresh and bitter water?
59_3_12: My brothers, can a fig tree produce olives, or a vine, figs? Nor can salt water produce fresh.
59_3_13: Who among you is wise and understanding? Let him show by his good behavior his works in the gentleness of wisdom.
59_3_14: But if you have bitter envy and selfish ambition in your heart, do not be arrogant and so lie against the truth.
59_3_15: This wisdom is not the kind that comes down from above — but is earthly, natural, demonic.
59_3_16: For where envy and selfish ambition are, there is disorder and every evil thing.
